owner_decisions.OD-1: live model inference: provider, model, credential provisioning outside the repository, per-gate spending cap and rate limits
owner_decisions.OD-2: whether live-model runs may ever execute in hosted CI (recommended: never; CI stays offline)
owner_decisions.OD-3: external research retrieval: source allowlist, licence and usage-rights policy, bandwidth limits
owner_decisions.OD-4: a human principal for escalations and reviews, registered by the owner out of band
owner_decisions.OD-5: symbolic-mathematics dependency and a formal proof checker (or the decision to have none)
owner_decisions.OD-6: inference budgets for the real-model grounding experiment and the long-horizon stages
owner_decisions.OD-7: whether a multi-host deployment is intended (changes the coordination design)
